translation_provenance.source_text_zh: 进场：执行 VTBS 20R RNP 进近需要注意。ATKIN 之后转 5 边的 航段， 管制可能会指令“maintain 5000ft，turn right HDG 165,intercept final course 20R,report established.”注意 管制是要求先建立20R RNP 的五边，而不是许可 RNP 进近,注意 证实指令，防止误待命APPR。随后会让下3500ft，可以 RNP20R，容易造成能量大，机组注意做好预案，防止不稳定。RNP 进近不 允许执行“高截获”程序。
translation_provenance.original_text_en: When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.
translation_provenance.text_en: When flying the VTBS 20R RNP approach, pay particular attention after ATKIN on the turn to final. ATC may instruct: "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." This requires first establishing on the 20R RNP final approach course; it is not clearance for the RNP approach. Confirm the instruction to avoid inadvertently arming APPR. ATC will subsequently clear descent to 3500ft and clear the RNP20R approach. This can result in high energy; plan ahead to prevent an unstable approach. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.
translation_provenance.review_note: 逐句保留先建立五边而非进近许可、证实指令、APPR、随后下降许可与能量风险。高截获保留原英文引号术语，不推断新程序。

曼谷素旺那普.source_text_en: During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

曼谷素旺那普.source_text_en: For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. If no instructions are given, 02L should proceed toF/W approach and wait outside the runway, while 20R should proceed to F/Z approach and wait outside the runway.

The ground frequency corresponding to the parking position can be found on the AMM chart.

曼谷素旺那普.source_text_en: When executing a VTBS 20R RNP approach, note the following: After the ATKIN, the control may instruct to "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." Note that the control requires establishing the 20R RNP five sides first, not granting permission for the RNP approach. Pay attention tothe confirmation instructions toavoid mistakenly awaiting the APPR. Subsequently, the control may descend 3500ft, allowing the RNP 20R approach, which could cause excessive energy. The crew should prepare contingency plans to prevent instability. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.

曼谷素旺那普.source_text_zh: 进场：执行 VTBS 20R RNP 进近需要注意。ATKIN 之后转 5 边的 航段， 管制可能会指令“maintain 5000ft，turn right HDG 165,intercept final course 20R,report established.”注意 管制是要求先建立20R RNP 的五边，而不是许可 RNP 进近,注意 证实指令，防止误待命APPR。随后会让下3500ft，可以 RNP20R，容易造成能量大，机组注意做好预案，防止不稳定。RNP 进近不 允许执行“高截获”程序。

曼谷素旺那普.source_text_en: During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.

曼谷素旺那普.source_text_en: For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. If no instructions are given, 02L should proceed toF/W approach and wait outside the runway, while 20R should proceed to F/Z approach and wait outside the runway.

曼谷素旺那普.source_text_en: Our aircraft is typically parked at Satellite-1 Hall-1. At Suvarnabhumi Airport, a PDC is available. Once the PDC is confirmed, there's no need for repetition — simply contact ground control to request the push-up command. The ground frequency corresponding to the parking position can be found on the AMM chart.

曼谷素旺那普.source_text_en: At Terminal S126 in Bangkok, the approach guidance system frequently exhibits abrupt switching: it may instantaneously shift from 2 meters to 0, then display "Stop"; after pressing "OK," the number may switch again, posing a risk of overshooting or failing to reach the correct position. Both flight crew and ground maintenance personnel have encountered this issue on multiple occasions.

曼谷素旺那普.source_text_en: During a cruise in the Bangkok area, the aircraft recently experienced multiple failures including NAV ADS-B RPTG 1+2 FAULT and NAV BKUP SPD FAULT, followed by GPS PRIMARY LOST on both sides. The crew should be thoroughly familiar with the technical notice, maintain awareness of the minimum safe altitude throughout the flight, and follow the technical notice for handling.

曼谷素旺那普.text: 执行 VTBS 20R RNP 进近需要注意。ATKIN 之后转 5 边的 航段， 管制可能会指令“maintain 5000ft，turn right HDG 165,intercept final course 20R,report established.”注意 管制是要求先建立20R RNP 的五边，而不是许可 RNP 进近,注意 证实指令，防止误待命APPR。随后会让下3500ft，可以 RNP20R，容易造成能量大，机组注意做好预案，防止不稳定。RNP 进近不 允许执行“高截获”程序。

In final approach, intercept or approach ILS course at 160-180 knots. When establishing ILS, maintain 160 knots.

english_excluded_source_clauses.clause: The new Z approach procedure is the primary procedure, and the navigation database has also changed. Carefully review the Warning notes on the corresponding arrival chart. Do not turn onto final approach to join the approach procedure without ATC clearance.
english_excluded_source_clauses.reason: English source is only applicable to the opposite operating role

english_excluded_source_clauses.clause: When flying the VTBS 20R RNP approach, pay particular attention after ATKIN on the turn to final. ATC may instruct: "maintain 5000ft, turn right HDG 165, intercept final course 20R, report established." This requires first establishing on the 20R RNP final approach course; it is not clearance for the RNP approach. Confirm the instruction to avoid inadvertently arming APPR. ATC will subsequently clear descent to 3500ft and clear the RNP20R approach. This can result in high energy; plan ahead to prevent an unstable approach. The "high intercept" procedure is not permitted during RNP approaches.
english_excluded_source_clauses.reason: English source is only applicable to the opposite operating role

english_excluded_source_clauses.clause: During 02L approach, the controller typically maintains a three-way approach while controlling the aircraft's distance from the front and rear. Subsequently, the controller directs the aircraft to fly directly to BATEM or ABVER. When initiating the 02LRNP approach plan, the MCDU will prompt the pilot to select VIA BATEM. If VIA is not selected, the BATEM point will not be visible on the plan.
english_excluded_source_clauses.reason: English source is only applicable to the opposite operating role

english_excluded_source_clauses.clause: For aircraft landing on 02L, execute F/W runway approach and wait outside the runway. Use W to cross the runway and proceed straight ahead. D4: Switch to 121.95 frequency to directly approach the parking position and taxi route. For example, S123 D taxi G, proceed forward, wait, then taxi to T18 or T19 for position change. Airport regulations specify: After landing on 02L/20R, do not remain on the quick departure runway to await taxi instructions. If no instructions are given, 02L should proceed toF/W approach and wait outside the runway, while 20R should proceed to F/Z approach and wait outside the runway.

Pilots must familiarize themselves with the specific taxiway number before each run, as itcorresponds to the standard taxiway for both departure and arrival.
